This role supports the ITO Project Logistics Leads in developing logistics concepts, budgetary freight estimates, transportation schedules, sourcing strategies, risk assessments, and tender assumptions. The Logistics Portfolio Manager reviews and challenges proposed logistics solutions to help ensure they are commercially competitive, operationally feasible, and aligned with project execution requirements. Following project award, the Logistics Portfolio Manager ensures the effective transition of logistics strategies, budgets, schedules, assumptions, risks, and contractual commitments from Inquiry-to-Order (ITO) to Order-to-Remittance (OTR). These positions report directly to the Logistics Portfolio Manager. The role oversees transportation procurement activities, including RFQ development, carrier bid analysis, commercial evaluation, supplier capability and risk assessment, negotiations, Statements of Work, purchase orders, and contract performance. Utilize analytics and reporting tools to improve logistics planning, transportation sourcing, portfolio management, and procurement decisions. Establish collaboration and feedback loops between the ITO Project Logistics Leads and OTR logistics teams to capture lessons learned and improve future planning and execution. Standardize logistics processes, templates, planning tools, governance practices, KPIs, and operational reporting. Drive continuous-improvement initiatives focused on execution readiness, operational efficiency, cost competitiveness, supplier performance, and supply-chain resilience. Support organizational change-management initiatives and cross-functional process improvements. Promote consistent use of approved logistics systems, tools, processes, and documentation standards across the portfolio. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner with Commercial, Sales, Engineering, Sourcing, Procurement, Manufacturing, Project Management, Finance, Customs and Trade Compliance, Corporate Logistics, and Site Operations teams to align logistics activities with business objectives. Maintain close alignment with ITO Project Logistics Leads to support tender development and ensure an effective transition into project execution. Build organizational logistics capability through coaching, mentoring, training, knowledge sharing, and development planning. Support talent assessment, succession planning, workforce planning, and recruitment across the logistics organization. Establish and maintain logistics governance, KPI management, operational reporting, and execution best practices. Influence stakeholders and drive timely decisions within a complex, matrixed organization. Foster effective communication, collaboration, and accountability across all functions involved in logistics planning and execution.
